name: WF1: AI Gateway - Unified Entry Point

parameters.query:
SELECT c.*, p.property_name, p.owner_name, p.preferred_platform
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN property_configurations p ON c.property_id = p.property_id
WHERE c.contact_id = $1
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1

meta.description: Unified entry point for all incoming messages. Uses AI to classify and route to appropriate handler.
